Class IntFraction

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Number
be.imgn.gaia.core.math.Fraction
be.imgn.gaia.core.math.IntFraction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Fraction>
public final class IntFraction extends Fraction
An exact fraction of two int values, always in lowest terms and with a positive denominator. 
var half = IntFraction.of(2, 4);            // 1/2
half.plus(IntFraction.of(1, 3));            // 5/6
half.times(IntFraction.of(-4));             // -2
half.compareTo(IntFraction.of(3, 5)) < 0;   // true
half.doubleValue();                         // 0.5

Two fractions are equal if and only if they have the same value, since each value has only one representation. A method whose result, once in lowest terms, has a numerator or a denominator that doesn't fit in an int throws ArithmeticException.

Since:
0.2.0
